notes.title: Winter Sale - 20% Off! Cat God Ranch x CATO New Updates! +10 Languages!
notes.content:
[h2]1. Winter Sale - Lowest Price at -20%[/h2]
We are participating in the Steam Winter Sale with a 20% discount, the lowest price ever!

[h2]2. Gameplay Updates[/h2]
[h3]New Cat Gods:[/h3]
[b]CATO:[/b] Start with [CATO] and [Toast], which merge when they meet. Actively throw [Toast] at a target animal.
[b]Kiddo:[/b] Steals one item from the shop. Cooldown resets after refreshing the shop four times.

[h3]New Animals:[/h3]
[b]Female Hornbill:[/b] Adds an [Egg] to an adjacent empty [Nest], which hatches into a random [Female Hornbill] or [Male Hornbill].
[b]Male Hornbill:[/b] Leaves with the [Female Hornbill] when adjacent, granting +3 contributions to all [Birds] on the field.

[h3]New Items:[/h3]
[b]Hourglass:[/b] Resets the [Timer] of one animal on the field every three days.
[b]Venom Orb:[/b] Doubles the stacks of [Poison] animals receive.
[b]Animal Pen:[/b] Multiplies gold earned from selling animals by X (X = the number of animals sold that day).

[h3]Item Updates:[/h3]
[b]Jump Shoes:[/b] [Gazelles] and [Zebras] move to another empty tile and gain +2 contributions when preyed upon.
[b]Bunny Vending Machine:[/b] Automatically sells X [Bunnies] each day for +5 gold per bunny (X increases by 1 each day, max 10).

[h3]Animal Updates:[/h3]
[b]Zebra:[/b] Gains +1 contribution when moving.
[b]Water Buffalo:[/b] Gains +1 contribution in [Water Puddles] and provides +1 can when removed.
[b]Raccoon:[/b] Earns +8 gold every three days, with its timer reduced by 1 when adjacent to a [Water Puddle].
[b]Stick Insect:[/b] Animals that die of old age no longer trigger its ability.

[h2]3. Supports 10 Languages[/h2]
The game now supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, and Spanish.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2797340/_/

Recently, we finally received a SteamDeck development kit from Steam! The next update will include SteamDeck controller support. A new family, map, and Cat God DLC are also on the way, so stay tuned! (Let us know in the comments what new species or animals you’d like to raise!)

notes.title: Nominate 《Cat God Ranch》 for the "Sit Back and Relax Award"!
notes.content:
Dear guys,

It has been over two months since the release of Cat God Ranch, and during this time, we've received a lot of feedback from all of you. We've also completed several updates, both big and small. Thank you so much for your support and love!

We believe that everyone has had moments in the game such as "being devoured by a saber-toothed tiger in a fiery rage," "getting ruthlessly 'assaulted' by a little hyena," "helplessly stuffing the warehouse with rabbits," "feeling irritable as the silly roebuck keeps selling everything," and of course, "the joy of the magpie's oioi," "the hilarity of Capybara’s constant pooping," and "the thrill of the alpaca and giant lizard dropping tons of coins." No matter what, we hope that Cat God Ranch brings a moment of relaxation and happiness to all players amidst your busy lives and work!

If you enjoy Cat God Ranch and are looking forward to new maps and animal families, feel free to vote for us above~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/3d23df530982848154d7b9d4977534480fca54b1.jpg[/img]

We hope you continue to enjoy the game, and from the three of us, thank you again for all your support!

-Tudou, Ly, Zx
-CrazyPotato Studio

notes.title: New Mode & New Updates & 10% OFF Discount! Leaderboard Reset! Update RoadMap！
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/e667de3efa2b566b9c06fd204f181cd0af76b615.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Discount Period[/h2]
The new [b]10% OFF [/b]discount period runs from November 5 to November 19.

[h2]New Mode:[/h2]
Adventure Mode: In each stage, Cat Gods will appear randomly, using their abilities to help animals earn coins. In this mode, the selection of external Cat Gods and toys is disabled. After feeding three Cat Gods, you’ll have a chance to choose an animal, toy, or Cat God.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/89674380d5ad7b4f3b1307d5359775828cfe04ce.jpg[/img]
[h2]Enhancements:[/h2]
Lioness: Preys on 1 adjacent 【Hoofed Family】
Extra Wool: Increased chance to add a 【Lamb】 from 30% -> 50%
Black and White Paint: When 【Gazelle】 swaps places with 【Donkey】 or 【Horse】, transforms them into 【Zebra】; swapping with 【Zebra】 grants an additional +3 coins
Jumping Shoes: 【Gazelle】 and 【Zebra】 move to nearby empty spaces and gain +2 contribution when preyed upon
Golden Egg: Each animal of the same kind on the field gives the animal hatched from an 【Egg】 +1 contribution
Charge Horn: 【Cheetah】 gains +1 coin for each move
Coupon: After each shop reset, a random item’s price is reduced by 2
Milker: Cows reduce the growth days of nearby 【Calves】 and 【Lambs】 by 1

[h2]New Props:[/h2]
Cub Snack: Contribution doubles when baby animals mature
Grass Shed: Gain coins equal to the animal's contribution when removed
Meat Rack: When the 【Carnivore Family】 successfully preys, it drops 【Premium Leftovers】, which no longer takes up space
Couch Potato Sofa: Animals that did not leave the field the previous day gain +2 contribution

[h2]Leaderboard Reset[/h2]
All leaderboards have been reset

notes.title: Updates!Leaderboard Reset!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/cac3f46feb574224916b35ed424fe48deb765071.png[/img]
Hi, fellow contributors, thank you all for your ongoing support and suggestions.We have implemented some feedback in the game and further optimized the current experience.We have made additional adjustments and optimizations to props, toys, the cat god, clarity, convenience, and more!
If you have any questions, feel free to provide feedback in the player group to help us make the game even better!Finally, Enjoy your contributions!
[h2]Prop Enhancements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Golden Bamboo: 【Panda】 increases contribution for all adjacent animals
[*] Bunny Vending Machine: Automatically sells X number of 【Bunnies】 daily, each +5 coins (X increases by 1 each day)
[*] Fox Tail: 【Fox】 food capacity +1, +1 contribution for every 6 successful hunts
[*] Meat Spice: For every 2 empty spaces on the field, 【Carnivorous】 +2 contribution
[*] Bag: Animals released after removing 【Pelican】 will inherit its contribution
[*] Colorful Bird Feather: 【Peacock】 ability affects all family animals
[*] Golden Birdcage: Birds cannot be hunted; for every 3 similar birds on the field, +1 contribution
[*] Sea Salt: +4 coins when 【Marine Family】 is 【Stranded】
[*] Royal Jelly: Animals gain +2 contribution after eating honey; Brown Bear gets an additional +2 contribution
[*] Grill: For each Turkey eaten in this round, +4 coins
[*] Leather Blindfold: Eagle food capacity +1, +1 coin for each successful hunt
[*] Growth Express: Contribution +2 for animals that grow from 【Calf】 or 【Lamb】
[*] Goat Horn: 【Lamb】 can only grow into 【Goat】; newly added 【Lamb】 after removing 【Goat】 will inherit contribution
[*] Camping Tent: One rarest animal on the field each day will not exit
[/list]
[h2]Toys:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Cat Climbing Frame: Success of animal hunts triggers effects twice
[*] New Cardboard Box: Choose one rare animal and item at the start of the game
[*] New Laser Pointer: Ordinary animals won’t appear when selecting animals; ordinary items won’t appear in the shop
[*] Number of selectable toys: 3 -> 4
[/list]
[h2]Cat God Enhancements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Big Brother Cat: Select 2 additional animals every 2 stages
[*] Lilia: +2 contribution after protecting an animal successfully
[*] Rune: Reduces all animals' 【Timer】 by -1 daily
[*] Lisa: +1 number of selectable animals; temporarily increases the probability of rare and above animals appearing after each refresh
[/list]
[h2]Animal Enhancements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ladybug: Contribution increased from 2 -> 4
[/list]
[h2]Pokedex Optimization:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Props will display associated animal families
[/list]
[h2]Other Optimizations:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fishnet gains a separate remove button
[*] Rarity probability also increases in Endless Mode
[*] Reduced amount of coins stolen by sand rats in the early game
[*] Added a “Restart” shortcut button (R), effective only on the first day
[/list]
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the stacking issue with the Ant Staff
[/list]
[h2]Leaderboard Reset[/h2]

notes.title: Animal Encyclopedia Series II
notes.content:
Hello, dear ranchers!

As the Next Fest officially rolls over —how did you enjoy playing with the rodent family?

In the first issue of our Animal Encyclopedia, we introduced you to our four animal families, giving you insights into their unique traits in both the game and real life! In this new issue, we'll provide a detailed look at some of the critters currently in the game and a sneak peek at the ones to come!

[b]Hyena[/b]
Hyenas in Cat God Ranch are the ultimate pranksters! These sly scavengers love to swipe extra coins whenever other animals get gobbled up nearby. Foxes, lynxes, tigers, snow leopards—none are safe from a hyena’s sneaky ambushes! If you’ve got valuable carnivores, think twice before inviting a hyena to the party!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/06e4ff2fe5c3392658b2987bfe714f40cb0b6928.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/0dac3f60009748bb79b72c8f38ff152d33ed4107.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/e7b829585f217295e61978418de45d654d73c072.jpg[/img]

[b]Pika[/b]
Pikas are nature’s little jokers: they look like mice but live like rabbits. In Cat God Ranch, these quirky critters can team up with both mice and rabbits for breeding. Beware, though—they breed like crazy and might overcrowd your ranch, leaving no room for your basic mice or rabbits. A pika-palooza indeed!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/29bc9163bad82671d1f89798bdc80e3aae89ae8b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/a0ef0f815deae05215cf309d5e24309827ce4dd7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/430dfd062a361d8922a1278314e734377e9e6d6f.jpg[/img]

[b]Hornbill[/b]
Meet the star-crossed lovers of the animal world! Hornbills are all about lifelong romance—if one dies, the other follows. The male hornbill is the perfect husband, gathering nest materials and playing chef for three months. In our game, male and female hornbills need to stick together. If one is missing, the other will soon leave. True love, hornbill style!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/55fb4988493a9174182c6eb7cb8f30851fce1fe0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893788/1f6d53c4a0bfaf038151cd7e95903571f489364b.jpg[/img]

That's all for this issue of the Animal Encyclopedia! Stay tuned for more fascinating facts about the various animals in our game, including those that are common, rare, or even extinct in real life!

P.S. If you love our game and the adorable animals in it, don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2797340/Cat_God_Ranch/]add Cat God Ranch to your wishlist[/url]! This way, you'll get timely updates, game news, and more animal encyclopedias!

Follow us on [url=https://x.com/catgodranch]Twitter[/url] or chat with us on [url=https://discord.gg/AUJNvDnVJq]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Cat God Ranch's Animal Wiki Ep. 1
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/a9df4f4b600add2e464d0e5148bd6f5d4bd31ce8.png[/img]
Hi everyone, we hope you're enjoying the Cat God Ranch demo so far! We've been hearing a lot of feedback from players about the different animals you can find in the ranch, and so, we're starting a new dev log series: the Animal Wiki! 

In this first episode, we'll introduce you to the four main animal families in the ranch. Three are already in the demo, with the fourth family to come. We'll dive into the different characteristics and commonalities these families share, so you can better understand the game too~

Let's get acquainted with all our furry friends in the ranch!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/90ab4be559806ce6d2d20107acd0617d60530e4b.png[/img]
Ungulates is just a fancy word for hoofed animals! The cows, sheep, rhinos, and reindeer you see in Cat God Ranch are all members of the hoofed family. In nature, these critters don't stop grazing and reproducing, and they can get very populous in the right conditions. In Cat God Ranch, it's the same concept - if you build up your herd of hoofed animals, they can earn you a steady stream of gold for your tribute!
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/b47ebc07f2b53557f8892a342fc208a3682e17a3.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/b356e7f1e26b5fd638b9da8e8f6a377cc8188ae7.png[/img]
Carnivores are one of the most diverse families both in nature and in the game. In Cat God Ranch, the carnivore family consists of friendly members like sheepdog and pandas, as well as tricky foxes and crafty hyenes, and hungry snow leopards and tigers that are always on the lookout for Ungulates to consume. Out in the wild, carnivores are well-adapted for survival since they're at the top of the food chains, and we've brought those tricks of the trade into the game. If you like an unconventional approach to playing Cat God Ranch, adding carnivores to your ranch is a must.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/296819f85c5a70d257777a613111cb18300d9d57.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/4c39a8b2bdf73e0c5bbbd5309af5bdb641dd9102.png[/img]
Cat God Ranch has a ton of birds, from common backyard fowl to more atypical avians like flamingos and peacocks. You've heard of the saying "birds of a feather flock together", right? Just like real life, the same applies in the ranch, where members of the Bird family enjoy flocking together. Keep enough of them and they'll start rapidly reproducing and increasing your gold income stream, too. But if you find your flock getting a little too overwhelming, just thin them out by introducing an eagle.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/66ac31e20ea51dec87b9e4ba7bf8e412d05a5a6c.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/f4c40872f535e8cce12d47759238ed8ec3aed2e2.png[/img]
The Pika family is not yet in the game, but will be launching soon! As you may have surmised from this family's name, these tiny critters are small and not particularly noticeable. But like in real life, they shelter in the ground and reproduce rapidly. Pika family members find safety in numbers, so give them enough of the right Terrain in your ranch and watch your income skyrocket!
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/b76d23508ebd071ad1ee5f0cdf5dc07aa14f95b0.png[/img]

These are the four animal families that you'll either meet, or soon meet, in Cat God Ranch! We have more animals coming, so stay tuned to the next episode of Animal Wiki~

If you like Cat God Ranch or think the animals are cute, wishlist us! We promise more content, fun, and derpy little animals to come~ 

P.S. Remember to follow us on [url=https://www.twitter.com/catgodranch]Twitter[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/MVCdsJhTx9]Discord[/url]!

[h1]Demo Updates[/h1]

[h2]Leaderboards[/h2]

The leaderboard will reset on May 14, 2024. The top player at the end of the ranking period will receive a special Cat God skin. This skin can only be won once by each player, so if you've won before, we hope you'll still play for fun :D 

To the player ELEVEN who won our last leaderboard challenge, please join our Discord so you can claim your custom skin prize!

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[*] Added animals: [b]Saber-toothed Tiger[/b] & [b]Snow Leopard[/b]
[*] Added a new Cat God, Lilia, with the ability to choose to protect an animal from being removed, sold, or eaten.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44893788/ba50913c23d02ad46c458e7a45f202b8f73f452a.jpg[/img]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sheepdog now earns 4 gold for every time it protects an animal, up from 2 gold
[*] Emperor Penguin now travels for 4 days and brings back 1 item on return
[*] Elk has been nerfed: X upper limit of 6 is now 3
[*] Magpie now has +1 contribution for every 3 or more identical birds on the field
[*] Lv1 carnivores now get +1 more gold when eating an animal; Lv3 carnivores receive the Predation ability. High rarity carnivores can also now eat low rarity carnivores and inherit their gold generation abilities.
[*] Hoofed animals added at Lv3 can inherit gold generation abilities
[*] Added extra stage in Lv2 Difficulty. There are now 10 stages.
[*] Achievements can now only be unlocked after you complete Lv2 Difficulty.
[/list]
[h2]Optimisations and Bugfixes
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimised some descriptions
[*] Optimised how the cooldown time of Cat God skills is displayed
[*] Added Esc and Space shortcuts
